title: Generic experimental-setup artefact
description: For physical sciences, engineering, social science, and other domains where PICO/PECO don't fit. Captures subject, manipulation, measurement, confounders, sample-size, and an optional DAG sketch.

subject.description: What is being studied — system, material, organism, population, simulation.

manipulation.description: What is being varied or perturbed. May be 'observation only' for naturally-occurring phenomena.

measurement.description: How the outcome will be measured — instrument, method, units.

controlCondition.description: What the manipulation is compared against.

expectedEffect.description: Prediction the hypothesis makes about the measurement.
